name: Maha Shivratri
significance: Great night of Shiva, celebration of divine union of Shiva and Shakti
rituals: Abhishekam with milk, honey, Ganga Jal
description: Maha Shivratri is one of the most sacred Hindu festivals dedicated to Lord Shiva, symbolizing the overcoming of darkness and ignorance in life.

name: Diwali (Deepavali)
significance: Festival of lights celebrating Lord Rama's return to Ayodhya and divine grace of Lakshmi
description: Diwali celebrates the triumph of light over darkness and good over evil across Sanatan Dharma.

name: Janmashtami
significance: Birth of Lord Shri Krishna in Mathura
description: Celebrates the birth of Lord Krishna, the eighth avatar of Lord Vishnu.
